header.running_head: The Marriages of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: The narration however adds at the end that Hadhrat Ummu Habeebah (RA) said, "After the Muslims had eaten and left and the money came to me, I sent for Abraha (RA) who had brought me the good news. I said to her, 'I gave you what I did that day only because I had no money then. Here are fifty gold coins. Please take it and use it for yourself.' She however produced a box containing everything I had given her. Returning it to me, she said, 'The king made me promise that I shall not take anything from you as long as I am in charge of his clothing and oils. I am also a follower of the Deen of Rasulullaah ﷺ and have submitted to Allaah. The king has already instructed his wives to send to you all the perfumes they have in their possession.' The next morning, she brought me plenty of fragrances such as Ood, Waras, Amber and Zabaad. I brought back all of this to Rasulullaah ﷺ and although he saw it with me and saw me wearing it, he never objected.

Abraha (RA) then said to me, 'My only request to you is that you convey my Salaams to Rasulullaah ﷺ and that you inform him that I have become a follower of his Deen. She treated me very kindly and even helped me prepare for the journey. Whenever she came to me, she would say, 'Do not forget my request.' When I got to Rasulullaah ﷺ and informed him about the proposal and the behaviour of Abraha (RA), he merely smiled and when I conveyed her Salaams to him, he replied by saying:
'May Allaah's peace, mercy and blessings be on her.' [^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Marriage to Hadhrat Zaynab bint Jahash (RA)

Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that when the Iddah of Hadhrat Zaynab bint Jahash (RA) had expired, Rasulullaah ﷺ told Hadhrat Zaid (RA) to ask her if she would marry him. When Hadhrat Zaid (RA) saw her as she was kneading dough, her status soared so much in his heart because Rasulullaah ﷺ wanted to marry her and that he was unable to even look at her. He therefore turned on his heels and facing his back to her, he said, "O Zaynab! Glad tidings to you! Rasulullaah ﷺ has sent me to propose for your hand in marriage." Hadhrat Zaynab (RA) replied by saying, "I am unable to do anything until I consult with my Rabb." She then stood at the place where she performed her salaah (and engaged in salaah). It was then that Allaah revealed some verses of the Qur'aan (in which Allaah says, "We married her (Zaynab) to you (O Rasulullaah ﷺ)..." [^2]). (Because Allaah had conducted the marriage) Rasulullaah ﷺ then went to Hadhrat Zaynab (RA) without needing to seek permission.

Hadhrat Anas (RA) says further, "I was also there when Rasulullaah ﷺ went to Hadhrat Zaynab (RA) and fed us bread and meat to celebrate the occasion. While some people (ate and) left, others remained behind in the room to talk
Haakim (Vol.4 Pg.20). Ibn Sa'd (Vol.8 Pg.97) has reported a similar narration.
